name: vscode-dev-protocol
description: Universal developer workflow protocol — @devprotocol agent + LM tools for GitHub Copilot. Enforces iterative planning, Zod JSON plans, branching strategy, document-first approach, and quality gates.

chatParticipants.name: devprotocol
chatParticipants.description: Universal dev workflow agent: iterative planning, Zod JSON plans, branching, document-first, quality gates.

commands.name: plan
commands.description: Start a new Zod JSON planning session for a feature or task

commands.name: session
commands.description: Create or update the current session log file

commands.name: apply
commands.description: Apply bundled instructions to the current workspace .github/instructions/

commands.name: review
commands.description: Review current plan progress and suggest next steps

languageModelTools.name: devprotocol_ask_questions
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Presents the user with structured choices: always 4 options (3 concrete + 1 freeform), with the best future-proof option marked. Loops until user confirms satisfaction. Use this instead of asking freeform questions.

options.description: Exactly 3 concrete options (freeform is always added automatically)

languageModelTools.name: devprotocol_create_plan
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Generates a structured Zod JSON plan with PRD, contesto, milestones, and issues with dependencies. Saves to .github/plan.json in the workspace. Use before starting any non-trivial task.

languageModelTools.name: devprotocol_log_session
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Creates or updates sessions-YYYY-MM-DD.md in the workspace root with milestone/issue progress, status, and work summary.

languageModelTools.name: devprotocol_create_branch
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Creates a git branch following the protocol naming convention (feat/, fix/, chore/, docs/ prefix). Validates no uncommitted changes exist before branching.

languageModelTools.name: devprotocol_document_first
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Fetches official documentation for a library via Context7 MCP before implementing. Always call this before writing code that uses an external library.

topic.description: Specific topic to fetch (e.g. 'reactive properties', 'async validators')

languageModelTools.name: devprotocol_enforce_quality
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Validates that a proposed solution follows: KISS, DRY, SOLID, Hexagonal Architecture. Rejects workarounds, patches, and band-aid fixes. Returns pass/fail with reasoning.

proposedSolution.description: Description or code snippet of proposed solution

languageModelTools.name: devprotocol_apply_instructions
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Copies bundled .instructions.md files and agent hooks from the extension to the current workspace. Instructions go to .github/instructions/, hooks config to .github/hooks/, and hook scripts to scripts/hooks/. Supports selective copy by category.

languageModelTools.name: devprotocol_run_subagent
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Delegates a focused research or execution task to a subagent for maximum efficiency. Specify thoroughness (quick/medium/thorough) and expected output format.

task.description: Detailed description of what the subagent should do

devprotocol.askQuestionsStyle.description: How devprotocol_ask_questions presents choices: in-chat replies or VS Code QuickPick

devprotocol.planOutputPath.description: Where to save Zod JSON plan files

devprotocol.sessionLogPath.description: Template for session log file path (supports {date} placeholder)

devprotocol.autoApplyInstructions.description: Automatically apply bundled instructions to new workspaces on first activation

devprotocol.autoSelectRecommended.description: Auto-select the recommended option in #askQuestions without showing picker
